name: Julian Kwan
subject: Economics and Maths
text: I had A level Economics tuition with Liane, she is a superb tutor who helped me get an A*. What made her lessons different from most other tutors is the personalised additional 'homework' she would set to complement every lesson. I also had Tania for A Level Maths tuition and she helped me get a very high A.

name: Antonia
subject: Sociology
text: I ended up receiving a result for sociology that I never thought I was capable of! Mark went above and beyond to ensure that I had all of the resources I could have possibly needed to aid my revision and was happy to answer all of my 1000s of questions.

name: A
subject: Psychology
text: Did psychology tutoring with Andy, absolutely excellent tutoring and amazing guy, took me from a C to an A nearly A star. Great teaching, sets good work and has plenty of his own made resources to practice from.

name: P “PS” She
subject: Maths
text: Our experience with Tania (maths tutor) has been outstanding. She was incredibly patient, created a personalised learning plan, and gave our daughter the attention she needed to thrive. Thanks to her guidance, my daughter achieved A grade at her A level and has secured a placement for Medicine.

name: C M
subject: Maths
text: I achieved an A in my A level Maths exam. What I absolutely loved about Tania's teaching was that on any topic I was struggling with she made sure I understood the underlying principles of that topic.

name: Elizabeth Z
subject: Psychology
text: Andy has been the absolute best with psychology tutoring! His lessons are always enjoyable and he teaches me in a way that I fully understand the topic and am able to then answer exam questions more successfully.
